about: The mod shop's curated list. The pages workflow takes each file from its author's GitHub release (repo, tag, file), or from their repository at a commit (repo, commit, path), checks it against the sha256 here, and puts it on the site; nothing here is committed but this list. Only mods whose licence allows passing them on. kind 'core': a core the listed mods need, added to the site's cores. needs_core: the oldest core version the mod links with. on_unit: what has been checked on real hardware, shown in the details sheet. license: only for a file that names none (then the repository's licence).

items.summary: Lets machine mods built for it share one build: it draws each machine's SRC and LFO pages from what the machine describes, and from 1.2 gives a machine seven more SRC values per sound and lets a page knob be a stock sound parameter. Needs core 3.0 or newer, which the shop takes for it; on its own it changes nothing. DT-FM 1.2.1, DIGISLICER 2.5 and digi1_mods' machines (Digi Mono, Digi Poly, Digi Macro, DH-101) are built for it. Not with the shop's machine mods that draw their own pages: NEIGHBOR 0.6 and SOPHIE.
items.on_unit: 1.2 ran on a Digitakt mk1, tested by the author with no problems, as did 1.0 (on OS 1.54 with core 3.0 and six machine mods built for it). 1.2 is also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.53 and 1.54 with core 4.0: every screen and the audio the same as stock.

Machines for the Digitone: sounds that play a machine mod's voice in place of FM, through the Digitone's own filter, mixer and effects, with the AMP page's envelope. MACHINES in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) picks the held track's machine, and a machine track's SYN1 and SYN2 knobs become the machine's. On its own it adds the menu and nothing else: a machine mod built for it ticks it here. Needs core-dn1 3.1, which the shop takes for it.

What the Digitone's effect mods share (DigiSwarm, DigiPrism, DigiTide, DigiTriad, DigiReel, DigiHoard, DigiHalo from 0.2): one effect at a time owns the audio, with a mixer around it (input levels as loud as the Digitone's own input), two LFOs on the stock LFO page, p-locks kept in the pattern and the MIDI hand-off. On its own it adds nothing: an effect that needs it ticks it here. Needs core-dn1 4.1, which the shop takes for it.
items.on_unit: Tested on a Digitone mk1 by its author with the 0.2 effects (Oct 2026); still a beta. Also checked in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. Not yet run on a Digitone Keys.

Version 0.5 replaces the earlier parameter layout: older sounds, locks and LFO assignments are not migrated. Newly saved sounds require compatible custom firmware.
